detail.longDescription: I've spent considerable time in my adult life on "choice architecture", meaning ways to coax desired behavior out of myself without exerting willpower. Phone use has been the main concern. Some things I've tried: I bought a Kitchen Safe timed box and would leave it in there for hours, sometimes days. I limited available iPhone apps with iMazing I hacked together blocking systems in Tasker on a Pixel. Currently, I'm running a vibe coded blocker app, device owner mode, on the pixel. Works ok, but a fair amount of upkeep and edge cases. What, if anything, have you tried?
